t.zh: 板上是你在<level-ref to="gen-one"></level-ref>搭的生成器，在它上面改。这一次输入的引入规则是一串，有几条都行，一条都没有也行。新元件「逐项处理」是一个框：对一串里的每一项各执行一遍，框里输出的东西排成新的一串。
t.en: The board holds the generator you built in <level-ref to="gen-one"></level-ref>; change it there. This time the intro rules come as a list, of any length, even empty. The new part For each is a frame: it runs once on each item of a list, and what it outputs inside forms a new list.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：由一份声明的一串引入规则，生成它的消去规则。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that makes a declaration’s elimination rule from its list of intro rules.

hint.zh: 一串引入规则和要生成的消去规则，各有几项？
hint.en: How many items does the list of intro rules have, and how many the elimination rule to make?

after.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:elimGen"></part-ref>现在跑的是这块电路。Lean 的内核也这样由一个类型的各个构造子生成它的<wiki-ref to="recursor"></wiki-ref>，所以不让人手写消去规则。
after.en: The <part-ref to="lemma:elimGen"></part-ref> now runs this board. Lean’s kernel likewise makes a type’s <wiki-ref to="recursor"></wiki-ref> from its constructors, which is why it never lets you write an elimination rule.
